dedupe_keys.name: sap e mobility smart charging optimiser

description: SAP's e-mobility smart-charging repository contains scheduling algorithms for electric-vehicle fleets, a REST service and a browser playground. JSON inputs define cars, energy demand, arrival information and a three-phase charging network with its fuse hierarchy. Outputs are charging schedules that can balance delivered energy, peaks and electricity cost. Spatial coverage is a configured charging installation; the documented experiments use daily schedules and changing vehicle availability. Apache-2.0 source is free and includes Java 8 backend and Angular 8 frontend instructions. A limitation is that the repository is archived and uses historical dependencies. Algorithm examples do not establish connection to physical chargers. The model supports depot-capacity and charging-control simulations and relates to OpenDSS (platform-opendss) for electrical-network analysis. The README cites work on real-time charging based on precomputed schedules. No charging service was started.
